title: Nine Miles of Walking
subtitle: 江河湖海 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 江河湖海（自然生态·海洋与河流）
meta: 主题语境：江河湖海（自然生态·海洋与河流）　|　核心词汇：beach　|　正文 328 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 beach 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1952 my mother walked nine miles to ① a beach and said the walking was the whole of the holiday. The ② beach, meaning the sand and not the sea, was covered in shells and was gone by eleven in the morning; a beach, she said, is the only place that disappears twice a day and is never missed.

Every ③ beach on that coast belonged to somebody, and the ④ beach below the cliff, meaning the one nobody could charge for and not either of those, was the only one she ever went back to. A beach, my grandmother said, is nine parts tide and one part a way down; my mother said the way down is the part nobody mentions.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ beach was the whole of the afternoon, meaning the hours and not the sand. The ⑥ beach, meaning the time and not any of that, is the only thing in a summer that everybody remembers and nobody can describe; a beach, he said, is either a piece of coast or the only word that means both a place and an afternoon. She said the afternoon is the part that lasts.

By 1969 the ⑦ beach had become a photograph in a frame, and the frame had become an argument about the weather. The ⑧ beach of the whole thing, my mother wrote in August, was nine miles of walking and eleven years of sand; a beach, she said, is either the strip below the cliff or the reason you learned the tide. He said the tide has never needed learning.

The ⑨ beach I remember is the one below the cliff, which was closed in 1972 and is still described as though it were open. A ⑩ beach, my grandmother said in 1974, is the only place that improves by being closed; every beach, she said, is an afternoon that has agreed to look like a coast. She said the afternoon was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 海滩（指那片沙，与海相对）
C. 固定搭配：walk nine miles to a beach 走九英里到一处海滩
D. n. 海滩（指那片海岸上每一处）
E. n. 海滩（指悬崖下那一处）
F. n. 海滩（指那个下午／那段时光）
G. n. 海滩（抽象：那段时光这件事）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a beach and said the walking was the whole of the holiday
The beach, meaning the sand and not the sea
beach was the whole of the afternoon
the beach had become a photograph in a frame
The beach of the whole thing
A beach, my grandmother said in 1974

answers.why: walk nine miles to a beach 意为“走九英里到一处海滩”，1952 年母亲走了九英里，说走路就是这个假期的全部。
beach 意为“海滩”，指那片沙而不是海，满是贝壳，十一点之前就被潮水淹了。
beach 指那片海岸上每一处海滩，每一处都有主人。
beach 指悬崖下那一处（没人能收费的那一处），是唯一她会再去的。
beach 意为“海滩”，指那个下午、那段时光，父亲说 beach 就是那个下午的全部。
beach 为抽象用法，指那段时光这件事，是夏天里人人都记得、却没人描述得出来的东西。
beach 意为“海滩”，到 1969 年这个 beach 成了相框里的一张照片。
beach 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲八月写道，整件事权衡下来是九英里的步行和十一年的沙子。
beach 意为“海滩”，我记得的是悬崖下那一处，1972 年被封闭，至今还被人说成是开着的。
beach 为抽象总称，祖母说海滩是唯一会因为被关闭而变好的地方。

那处海滩，指的是那片沙而不是海，满是贝壳，十一点之前就被潮水淹了。（beach）
那片海岸上每一处海滩都有主人。（beach）

父亲说 beach 就是那个下午的全部，指的是那段时光而不是那片沙。（beach）
1974 年祖母说，海滩是唯一会因为被关闭而变好的地方。（beach）

The beach, meaning the sand and not the sea, was covered in shells and was gone by eleven in the morning.
Every beach on that coast belonged to somebody.
The beach below the cliff, meaning the one nobody could charge for and not either of those, was the only one she ever went back to.
My father said beach was the whole of the afternoon, meaning the hours and not the sand.
A beach, my grandmother said in 1974, is the only place that improves by being closed.
